title: Procurement purchase-to-pay (BPI Challenge 2019)
world: One multinational company's purchase-order line items for 2018: buyers create orders, vendors invoice, goods are received, accounts payable matches and clears invoices, with payment blocks and rework when documents disagree. 607 specialized human users, 20 batch jobs, vendors as external actors.
status: initialized; baseline and two interventions run

scenarios.title: Baseline: 2018 operations as observed
scenarios.description: Replays arrivals from the training window and simulates the workforce with calibrated service times, approval rules and payment-block behavior.

scenarios.title: Automated three-way match (+2% tolerance)
scenarios.description: An agent capability clears invoice/PO/GR mismatches within a 2% tolerance without a human touch, removing most manual payment-block work.

scenarios.title: Accounts payable headcount -20%
scenarios.description: Stress test: the AP team shrinks by a fifth with unchanged arrivals; measures queue growth and payment delays.

bindings_problems: role:batch_job has no onet_code (automated seat; allowed)
